verdicts.reason: A: only a tiny black box with 'MOVIE NIGHT' survives on the left; the date, film title, venue and URL are white text spread straight over the busy doodle background, so they can't be read. B is worse: the black panel has shrunk to a sliver at the far right and all its copy has escaped onto the doodles, where the white text breaks up into noise with no hierarchy. Neither is usable, but A at least keeps the headline legible and reading first.
